description: This Java source file defines the SerialManager class responsible for handling serial communication. It includes a DataListener to process incoming data and references external classes like LinkManager and ConnectionStateListener. The class also contains commented-out code for serial port enumeration and port type identification, indicating potential functionality for port discovery.

classes.name: SerialManager
classes.description: Manages serial port communication, processes incoming data via a DataListener, and references external link management and connection state.

methods.name: onDataArrived
methods.description: Callback invoked when data arrives on the serial connection, passing data to the LinkManager for processing.
